decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The use hereby permitted shall not commence until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the car wash against internally generated sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 3 - Before the construction of the car wash hereby permitted commences on site, an investigation shall be carried out to identify the extent of contamination and the results provided to and agreed with the Local Planning Authority.  A scheme for any decontamination of the site shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing and the scheme as approved shall be fully implemented and completed before the development hereby permitted is first occupied/utilised.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Installation of 5  no roller shutter door opening to existing window openings, formation of 1 no roller shutter door opening and construction of car wash.
